messages:
zoe: Quick sync — we need to lock agenda owners for the next 6 weeks of roadmap / design / triage. Can folks nominate themselves? prefer single owner per session to avoid split custody.

mike: I can take next Tue 9:00am PT (works for EMEA overlap) — can we alternate a deep-design slot on Thu every other week?

emma: Heads up we have an RFC review backlog; if we don't slot it it'll pile up. Proposal: rapid 30m triage + 60m deep design alternating weeks.

ravi: Timezones note — Tue 9am PT = 5pm UK, okish but meh for APAC. Can we rotate to cover APAC once a quarter? suggest a simple rotating ledger.

zoe: :thumbsup: good point. Proposed spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/sync-schedule — please mark avail. I'll try to automate roster once owners confirmed.

lina: I can own Thu deep design on 2026-03-25 and 2026-04-08. Also volunteer to own the decision-log row for design reviews.

mike: :eyes: @emma — can you take RFC-owner on 2026-03-22? I can pick up 2026-03-29.

emma: Yep I can take 2026-03-22. I'll add an initial decision-log row after the call.

mike: Quick ask — can we standardize the agenda template? e.g.
```
- Quick wins (5m)
- RFC reviews (20m)
- Design deep-dive (30m)
- Action items + owners (5m)
```

zoe: That template works. @ops-bot can you create a weekly recurring event with the template and attach a shared doc?

ops-bot: task created — /calendar create "Eng-Product Sync" weekly Tue 09:00 PT with agenda template. Link: https://tiny.redwood/cal/eng-prod-sync

mike: :thumbsup: also suggest we keep an "agenda owner" who compiles PRs + notes and writes decision log entry. owner should nominate two backups. votes?

zoe: If no objections by EOW we'll adopt rotation: owner picks two backups and updates ledger. Also add APAC rota once per quarter.

emma: :white_check_mark: agree

ravi: :white_check_mark: agree

lina: :white_check_mark: agree — I'll take 2026-03-25 design owner

zoe: Great — I'll compile the roster and post final list + decision-log template. Thanks all :tada:
